## Experience

- WLF Club (Growth & AI Automation, May 2026-present, Fort Worth TX): analyzed 780+ CRM opportunities in GoHighLevel, found 95% never reached a decision despite a 92% win rate when worked, and moved WLF's growth strategy from ad spend to backlog conversion. Trained an internal RAG AI (Warvis) on the business's own data, built a 25-module staff training site and internal ops dashboard, and stood up the full analytics stack (GA4, Search Console, Clarity, Meta Pixel) across the site and three lead-generation funnels, capturing 588 users and 1,109 pageviews in a 28-day window.
- Webspansion & Prospansion (founder, Apr 2024-present): Webspansion (free tier) is a pro bono studio: 19+ free live websites shipped as community service for nonprofits, immigrant-owned local businesses, and community groups, solo, accessibility-first, intake through deploy. Prospansion (paid tier) is the technical/data arm offering analytics, SEO, and automation; its flagship is Prospansion Studio, a multi-tenant Cloudflare Workers + D1 CMS with hardened auth (invite-only signup, hashed tokens, single-use resets) and a fixed sanitizer-bypass XSS vulnerability verified via exploit proof-of-fix, deployed for nonprofit client Ocura.

## Projects

- Local-First AI & Knowledge Systems (Warvis, Kiln): Warvis is a RAG knowledge system ingesting 700+ documents into a cited hybrid-search graph (SQLite FTS5 + local embeddings) with a HIPAA-aware PHI-scanning gate on every query (152 passing tests). Kiln is a self-improving training loop that raised a local model's eval score from 0.84 to 0.99, gated against a held-out baseline.
- [Guruji](https://getguruji.com): gamified Duolingo-style learning PWA (React, TypeScript, Supabase) with RLS-scoped auth and a self-run security audit against the live database (zero exploitable vulnerabilities). Multi-track curriculum: Data Decoded (data science) and QuickClaude (coding) alongside English and digital-literacy content.
- [BohoQuest](https://app.bohoquest.app): gamified check-in app (Expo/React Native) with server-side anti-cheat verification, Apple Sign-In, and a 121-test suite. Live in TestFlight.
- [PickMyPath](https://app.pickmypath.app): guitar-learning app, live but paused: chord-aligned lyrics, 73-song structured dataset, recommendation engine (Next.js, Supabase/PostgreSQL).
- [BohoBites Analytics](https://github.com/ashmitbohora/bohobites_dashboard): Python/Shiny dashboard processing real TikTok creator data (rolling KPI windows, posting-time models) for BohoBites, a 6K+ follower food brand.
- BoHub: local-first AI personal OS: Claude API tiered model routing, SQLite full-text search, security model.
